After processing all instances... Overall Predictive Accuracy (f_acc(z))... The ECE for exemplar set z is the weighted average of the absolute differences between average accuracy and average confidence
Overall Predictive Accuracy (f_acc(z)) ... The ECE for exemplar set z is the weighted average of the absolute differences between average accuracy and average confidence across all bins.
